body: Canonicalise the rare-type scoreboard: run scripts/rare_type_gold_review.py, hand-verify the ~120-row gold sample (positives + FP columns per type), feed verdicts back to upgrade the scoreboard from a proven relative round-vs-round comparator to an absolute GO/NO-GO gate (choice 0093 GO-precision is currently unvalidated).

Header-hint deletion is BLOCKED on training-data fortification (choice 0094, memory header-hint-deletion-blocked-multi-instrument). Wholesale delete/defer regressed (delete: gate NO-GO + m-19 -4pp; defer: m-19 -1.7pp). Revisit per-arm ONLY after fortification turns the model-gap families (url/datetime/isbn/postal/amount, header_hint_cross_domain) model-covered, then re-measure on all four instruments.

Re-baseline the multi-lens diagnostic on v19. Its corroborated gaps (eval/gittables/corpus_pass/report.md) were scored against v22 false positives and the rare-type-blind metric; re-run against shipped v19 + the rare-type scoreboard before treating any gap as a retrain target.
